title: Bee Removal in South Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in South Bronx. Licensed technicians, nest treatment, and entry-point sealing.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect removal services throughout South Bronx, protecting residents and businesses from wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from residential buildings, commercial properties, and multi-family units across the neighborhood. Serving the Bronx community, we deliver fast, thorough nest treatment and removal — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
whyUs: Our South Bronx bee removal specialists respond quickly to service calls throughout Mott Haven, Melrose, and Port Morris, understanding the unique challenges of bee infestations in the area's diverse mix of pre-war walk-ups, NYCHA housing, and renovated lofts. We combine humane removal techniques with preventative solutions to keep your property bee-free year-round.
localContext: South Bronx's vibrant neighborhoods, from the historic Hub district to the waterfront areas near Yankee Stadium, feature aging brick buildings and active commercial corridors where wasps and hornets often nest in wall voids, fire escapes, and roof overhangs. The area's growing green spaces and community gardens attract yellow jackets and ground-nesting bees, making professional nest removal essential for property owners throughout this rapidly revitalizing section of the Bronx.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in South Bronx?
faqs.answer: We typically respond to South Bronx nest removal requests within 24 hours and can often provide same-day service for emergency situations. Most wasp and hornet nest treatments are completed in 2–4 hours depending on colony size and location accessibility.

faqs.question: What's included in the nest removal price?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in South Bronx?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Do you remove nests from older South Bronx apartment buildings?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in wasp and hornet nest removal from all types of South Bronx properties, including pre-war walk-ups, brownstones, and multi-family buildings. Our technicians are experienced working with the unique architecture of older Bronx buildings and can safely access nests in walls, cornices, and other hard-to-reach areas.
